anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to format the dataset, not a paper describing this dataset.

anchors.paper_title: iEEG-BIDS, extending the Brain Imaging Data Structure specification to human intracranial electrophysiology
anchors.reason: iEEG-BIDS is a specification for organizing intracranial EEG data, which this BIDS dataset follows; it does not describe this dataset itself.

metadata.methods_description: Intracranial EEG data were collected during natural listening tasks, including movie trailer viewing and TIMIT speech corpus presentation, in patients undergoing clinical epilepsy monitoring. Some recordings include seizure-related activity and VNS artifact for illustrative purposes.

funding.funder_name: National Institutes of Health - National Institute on Deafness and Other Communication Disorders
